dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: #Hey there, {NICKNAME}. Seems like this sea of flowers caught your eye as well?

choices.text: I'm here to take pictures of the flowers.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: That's a great idea, but I don't think you can take pictures without a Kamera. Are you sure you brought yours?

choices.text: I'm here to take pictures of you.
